tooltips.approveCommentDisabled: If checked, approvers can't add a comment when they approve. They only confirm the decision.
tooltips.declineCommentDisabled: If checked, approvers can't add a comment when they decline. They only confirm the decision.
tooltips.listDisplay: How the field looks in list views. Summary: the counter, like "1/3 Pending". Approvers: each user's name as a colored label. Summary + Approvers: both.
tooltips.approvalMode: Parallel: all approvers can act at the same time, in any order. Stages: approvers are grouped into stages. A stage starts when everyone in the previous stage has approved.
tooltips.approvalsAudited: If checked, the Stream logs each decision (with the stage and comment) and each change to the approver list.
tooltips.actionsPosition: Where the Approve and Decline buttons are shown on the record's detail view.
